summary: Possible typosquat of electron-builder with no malicious payload
details: The package name '@403name/electron-buidler' is a one-character misspelling of the widely-used 'electron-builder' package, and the README explicitly acknowledges this. The shipped code is an inert stub that logs messages and creates an output directory; there are no install lifecycle hooks, no network I/O, no credential access, no obfuscation, and no shell execution. Installer-side data and environment are not touched. The risk is confusion: a developer who mistypes the dependency name in package.json will silently pull this stub instead of the real electron-builder, causing builds to produce no real artifact. Routing to human review because name-similarity classification is inherently subjective and warrants a maintainer/registry decision rather than an automated block.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
